text.p: Bermuda-based PartnerRe Ltd is set to announce Monday it agreed to buy Societe Anonyme Francaise de Reassurances from Swiss Reinsurance Co for about $950 million, the Wall Street Journal said.
PartnerRe would pay about $800 million in cash and about 6.5 million PartnerRe shares for Societe Anonyme, the paper said Monday. It cited people familiar with the matter.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
PartnerRe said Feb. 26 it reached an understanding with Swiss Re which gave it the opportunity to consider the purchase of Societe Anonyme Francaise, a European reinsurer based in Paris.
